tree.noCreate: You may not add pages in this space

home.title: Pages
home.emptyTitle: No pages in this space yet
home.emptyBody: Keep your team's knowledge in one place: open a blank page, start from a template or import Markdown files.

page.title: Page title
page.lockedBanner: This page is locked. Writing is off to prevent accidental changes.
page.inTrash: This page is in the trash. Restore it from the Drive trash.
page.collabDenied: The collaboration server did not let you open this page. Reload the page.

status.offline: Offline · {count, plural, =0 {changes kept on this device} one {# change on this device} other {# changes on this device}}

editor.label: Page content
editor.placeholder: Start writing or type / for commands…

slash.embedDesc: Embed a Drive file, board or drawing in the page
slash.subpageDesc: Create a page under this one and link it
slash.tableEmbedDesc: Show a table from the Tables module, live, on this page

menu.follow: Follow: tell me when it changes
menu.followingDescendants: Following with sub-pages, click to stop

comments.title: Comments
comments.first: Write a comment, @ to mention someone
comments.noneOpen: No open comments. Select text and press Comment.

versions.title: Version history
versions.readOnlyChanges: Read-only · {count, plural, =0 {no changes} one {# change} other {# changes}} since the previous version
versions.restored: The page is back to this version; the previous state was kept as a version.
versions.restoredLive: The page was restored to an earlier version.

templates.title: Templates
templates.hint: The template's content is copied, with no link back; «date» and «author» are filled in.
templates.name: Template name

import.title: Import
import.hint: Markdown or Word files, a folder or an export package: folders become the page tree, images come along.
import.filesHint: .md, .docx or an Outline / Notion / Confluence (HTML) export package (.zip)
import.folderHint: An unpacked Outline, Notion or Confluence export; images come along
import.done: {count, plural, one {# page imported.} other {# pages imported.}}

warning.unreadable: file could not be read, skipped
warning.too_many: one import takes at most 200 pages, skipped

import.attachments: {count, plural, one {# image or attachment uploaded to Drive.} other {# images or attachments uploaded to Drive.}}

search.title: Search
search.hint: Titles, block content, closed toggles, code blocks and comments are searched.

export.title: Export
export.hint: Turn {name} into a file to download. Images and attachments come along.
export.childrenHint: One ZIP file; links between the pages work between the files too.
export.runningHint: The download starts when it is done. If you close this, a notification brings the file.
export.failed: The export failed. Try again in a moment.

lists.recentEmptyBody: Pages you open and edit are listed here by day.
lists.favoritesEmptyBody: Star a page with ☆ in its header, or right-click it in the tree and choose Add to favorites.

tableEmbed.pickBody: The table shows live on the page; rows are edited in the table itself.
tableEmbed.none: This space has no tables yet

portal.title: Send to Portal
portal.hint: “{name}” becomes a draft doc on the portal. Sending again to the same version and language updates that draft; publishing happens in the Portal.
portal.noSites: This organization has no portal site.
portal.note: Images on the page are copied to the portal media and internal links become plain text. Mentions and embedded items do not appear when published.
portal.created: “{name}” was sent to the portal as a draft
portal.updated: The portal draft of “{name}” was updated
portal.imagesSkipped: Images left out because they could not be read: {count}
